Hall Of Fame Info

Official VNL Hall Of Fame entry requirements.

Criterios

Players must meet the Hall Of Fame requirements below to appear on the VNL HOF board.

  • 135 points in the HOF table.
  • 7x Top 1 in any position.
  • 20x Top 5+ in any position. Top 1 counts are included here.
  • 3x seasonal LB in Top 5 or lower, in any position.
  • 1x Top 1 seasonal LB in any position.
  • 2x All Star.
  • 1x Champion.
